notes.title: Episode 7 of the Dev Series is live!
notes.content:
In this episode of the Dev Series we tackle the potentially contentious topic of balancing difficulty and games as well as the way that we try to process feedback from players who have tried to demo.

[url=https://youtu.be/6rAPKZLmtis]Watch the latest episode on our YouTube channel[/url] and don't forget to tell us what you'd like to see covered in the future!

notes.title: We just recorded a Dev Commentary for Patron Demo #03!
notes.content:
Patron Demo #03 is available now to patrons and to coincide with the completion of the opening mission we have made a new Dev Commentary to walk you through our first boss fight!

There's a little preamble in the last areas of the Goliath Basements to get you warmed up and then it is straight into the Corpse Processor encounter.

Watch [url=https://youtu.be/pTUKKPwrr0s]Fighting the First Dream Eater | DEV COMMENTARY - EP03[/url] on YouTube now!

notes.title: Patron Demo #03 is Playable Now!
notes.content:
Patron Demo #03 is now available for our supporters on Patreon!

After fighting through the Goliath Offices, Klo finds her partner Gabe in the clutches of a Dream Eater. Master her new Unicorn abilities and survive the first boss fight to escape the Goliath Offices!

For more information on how to get the demo, visit the [url=https://www.patreon.com/SamuraiUnicorn]Samurai Unicorn Patreon[/url]!

notes.title: Episode 6 of the Dev Series is out now!
notes.content:
In the latest instalment of the Dev Series we talk about the level design of the Goliath Offices and the guiding principles that we try to keep in mind when working on new missions for the game. There also a little tease for the upcoming boss fight that will wrap up the Goliath Offices demo...

[url=https://youtu.be/-VC7JQdJ8p4]Watch the episode on our YouTube channel[/url] and don't forget to tell us what you'd like to see covered in the future!

notes.title: Dev Commentary for our second Patron Demo is now live!
notes.content:
Patron Demo #02 has been available for a couple of months now, so we decided to do another Dev Commentary and walk you through the new areas. 

In the second commentary, Jordan and Adam take you through the Goliath Basements while discussing the new Unicorn abilities that you will have to master in order to survive against the more dangerous VRmin types.

Watch [url=https://youtu.be/QJHWr9Hg4pk]Surviving the Goliath Basements | DEV COMMENTARY - EP02[/url] on YouTube now!

notes.title: Watch Dev Series Episode 5 Now!
notes.content:
We're back with a new episode of the Dev Series! In this instalment we take a look at the design philosophy behind our basic VRmin Type as well as giving a quick peek under the hood of the enemy AI controller.

[url=https://youtu.be/6lX38c3pC4o]Take a look at the new episode[/url] and catch up on the previous ones over on the Samurai Unicorn YouTube channel!

notes.title: Patron Demo #02 is Available Now!
notes.content:
Patron Demo #02 is now available for our supporters on Patreon!

Klo descends into the Goliath Basements and must fight through the infested underbelly in search of her partner. Players will have to master Klo's newly acquired Unicorn Abilities in order to survive against the new VRmin types waiting in the depths.

For more information on how to get the demo, visit the [url=https://www.patreon.com/SamuraiUnicorn]Samurai Unicorn Patreon[/url]!

notes.title: Unicorn Gameplay Debuted During The Horror Game Awards
notes.content:
The team at The Horror Game Awards invited us to premiere a new trailer during the event and we took the opportunity to show more of the Unicorn combat abilities that Klo will have to master as well as the next area that will be added to the patron demo.

You can watch the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xWBfNcuV_Bo]Exclusive Teaser on YouTube now[/url]!

And if you missed [url=https://www.youtube.com/live/lNM2mQZh1O8?si=BCMpsAxTMh8OkvU9]The Horror Game Awards livestream[/url], it is also available as a VOD.

notes.title: Our first Dev Commentary and Playthrough is live!
notes.content:
Patron Demo #01 has been available for a few months now, so it seemed like a good time to do a playthrough and provide some insight into the environment art/encounter design of the introductory mission.

In this first dev commentary, Jordan and Adam sit down to play the latest build of the Goliath Offices and tease some of the updates you can expect to see in future demos.

Watch [url=https://youtu.be/4orBWJWwtqg]Exploring the Goliath Offices | DEV COMMENTARY[/url] now on YouTube!

notes.title: Dev Series Episode 4 is out now!
notes.content:
In the last episode of the dev series for 2023, we're looking at why Bonus Costumes are such an important part of games and why we love making them for Klo!

We'll be back in early 2024 with more episodes of the devlog, but we need to focus all our efforts on Demo #02 before the holidays roll around.

Anyway, you can [url=https://youtu.be/jFbwIFUFwpg]EP04 - The Joy of Bonus Outfits[/url] on YouTube now!

notes.title: Samurai Unicorn Makes an Appearance at The Indie Horror Showcase
notes.content:
We were invited by Horror Visuals to take part in The Indie Horror Showcase presented by DreadXP and The Mix on the 19th of October 2023. It was a huge line up of exciting Indie horror games and we are so proud to have been featured as part of Horror Visuals Official Selections.

Don't worry if you missed the livestream, you can watch the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LXFKP1R_PJ4]VOD on YouTube now[/url]!

And if you'd like to rewatch our new teaser trailer, you can also [url=https://youtu.be/cey1YkwO17o]check that out here[/url]!

After you watch the stream, make sure you head over to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/DreadXP/sale/TheIndieHorrorShowcase]Steam Event page[/url] and wishlist the games that caught your attention!

notes.title: Episode 3 of the Dev Series is Available Now!
notes.content:
We're back with another instalment of our Dev Series! This time round we're going into all the level design details and how we create environment art for a playable space.

Don't forget to let us know what you'd like to see covered in future episodes.

You can watch [url=https://youtu.be/yCEYmxW-tz8]EP03 - Establishing an Environment[/url] on YouTube now!

notes.title: Watch Dev Series Episode 2!
notes.content:
Episode 2 of our Dev Series is out now! Following along each month as we tackle different areas of development and provide some extra insight into the creative process of making Samurai Unicorn.

In the second episode, Adam and Eric join us to talk about how the art of character design and animation blend trees come together to create a protagonist worth caring about.

Watch [url=https://youtu.be/yKQdXc2ZWhg]EP02 - Creating Klo[/url] now on YouTube!

notes.title: Dev Series Episode 1 Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44319984/4f8bf852cd3a8c6c92d8104fb73d23d00f9c5b89.jpg[/img]

To coincide with the release of our patron demo, we have just launched our dev vlog series that will give a greater insight into our process as we work towards the completion of our full opening mission demo.

In this first episode, the game director of Samurai Unicorn outlines our hopes for the future of the game as well as the 3 main demo updates supporters on Patreon should expect to see over the next 6 months.

Watch [url=https://youtu.be/X5EakQC4H8w]EP01 - Welcome to Sydney3[/url] now on YouTube!

notes.title: Patron Demo #01 Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44319984/ff1abdc6fdb0c386a3714b1d0931ebf2f71f6b74.png[/img]Patron Demo #01 is now available to all of our supporters on Patreon! 

Take control of Klo and explore the abandoned Goliath Offices in search of something that will incriminate the megacorporation. Players will have to master Klo’s handgun and shotgun if they want to survive against the two types of VRmin hiding in the claustrophobic office spaces.

For more information on how to get the demo, visit the [url=https://www.patreon.com/SamuraiUnicorn]Samurai Unicorn Patreon[/url]!

notes.title: I'm not sure what this action horror game is about but I love the creepy enemies
notes.content: "In the sprawling megacity of Sydney3, a young detective becomes the unwilling host of a parasitic gauntlet and gains the power to fight back against the growing threat spreading through the lower levels," begins the description for Samurai Unicorn, an in-development lofi horror game that I am honestly immediately intrigued by based entirely on the strength of the visuals of its enemies, the VRmin. Get it? Vermin, but infected by evil VR headsets or whatever. VRmin... Read more.
